endorsements.quote: Standardized, comprehensive training is essential to mitigate automation bias, optimize the human-AI interface, and ensure AI meaningfully enhances screening mammography accuracy and efficiency.
Moreover, clinical effectiveness evaluation should move toward prospective, pragmatic randomized clinical trials to evaluate performance and outcomes in real-world settings.

To move toward broader adoption of AI for mammography screening, the field will require additional external validation of performance across different commercial AI algorithms and real-world community settings.

unlisted_practices: Extend AI mammography research to digital breast tomosynthesis screening.
Optimize AI algorithms to perform well in dense breasts and to distinguish ductal carcinoma in situ from benign calcifications.
Gather evidence on AI effectiveness before widespread adoption.

screen.reason: Title indicates a commentary or perspective discussing the evidence base needed for implementing AI in mammography screening.
